fields.description: Classic court style, in colors that are hard to ignore. Fifteen fresh shades, including eight Pantone-curated colors, on subtly textured hemp-and-cotton canvas. Lightweight, breathable, easy to wear on repeat. Comfortable enough for all day. Simple enough to go with everything.
fields.care: Yes, they're machine washable. Remove the insoles, hand wash those separately, and let everything air dry. Fresh again.
fields.fit: The Cruiser Canvas fits true-to-size for most customers.
key_features: Hemp and organic cotton canvas upper is light, breathable, and durable
Merino wool-blend lining for softness, socks optional
Sugarcane-based SweetFoam® cushioning with responsive energy return
Plush Featherbed™ memory foam insole for extra comfort and bounce

materials.upper: Canvas - Canvas upper made from a breathable blend of hemp and organic cotton
materials.midsole: SweetFoam® - SweetFoam® sugarcane-based EVA foam provides comfort and durability while being light on the planet
materials.lining: Wool - Merino wool blend lining for uncompromising comfort and softness
